title: Digital Video Editing with Adobe Premiere Pro: The Real-World Guide to Set Up and Workflow
review: This is so imaginative and unique. And it does what I most like to see in horror movies: withholding all the surprises and all the effects budget for the very end. It's mostly told through screen recording of someone pottering around in Premiere, although you experience a bit of the story they are editing this way, too. There's sharp dialogue between the director and editor characters, and it gives an interesting insight into the editing process too. Best of all: it's only 40 minutes.
